# Franka ROS 2 interface packages

The `franka_msgs` and `franka_spine_msgs` directories are unmodified copies
from Franka Robotics' `franka_ros2` release `v3.4.1`, pinned to commit:

```text
b4164f555500fe50c3f44f24d4cccc452ffac442
```

Upstream: <https://github.com/frankarobotics/franka_ros2>

They are included so a clean Docker build contains the exact ROS interfaces
needed by this policy. The upstream Apache License 2.0 is preserved in
`LICENSE`.
